title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 112 Wyoming Street in Shoshoni, Wyoming, as the "Dessie A. Bebout Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 112 Wyoming Street in Shoshoni, Wyoming, as the Dessie A. Bebout Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress renamed the Shoshoni, Wyoming post office after Dessie A. Bebout.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service building at 112 Wyoming Street in Shoshoni, Wyoming, the Dessie A. Bebout Post Office. It only changes the name of the building. It does not change how mail is delivered or what services the office offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 25, 2024.
